library(ggplot2)

# Figure 3: Costs of establishment phase for each degree of protection

```{r}
# making prediction 
esubs <- esubs |> 
  filter(!is.na(Years)) 

pred_draws1 <- emmeans(
  esubs.brm1,
  ~ Years | Protection_level,
  at = list(
    Years = seq(min(esubs$Years), max(esubs$Years), length.out = 100),
    lSize = mean(esubs$lSize, na.rm = TRUE),
    Protection_level = unique(esubs$Protection_level))) |>
  gather_emmeans_draws()

pred_year1 <- pred_draws1 |>
  group_by(Years, Protection_level) |>
  summarise(
    estimate = median(.value),
    lower = quantile(.value, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(.value, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    median = exp(estimate),
    lower = exp(lower),
    upper = exp(upper))

# plotting 
fpey <- subset(pred_year1, Protection_level == "Fully protected")
mubsey <- subset(pred_year1, Protection_level == "Partially protected")
# Create the plot - base plot 
neyear_pl <- 
  ggplot() +
  # Fully protected areas
  geom_line(data = fpey, aes(x = Years, y = median, color = "Fully protected areas"), size = 0.8) + #, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(data = fpey, aes(x = Years, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = "Fully protected areas"), alpha = 0.2) +
  # Partially protected areas
  geom_line(data = mubsey, aes(x = Years, y = median, color = "Multi-use areas"), size = 0.8) + #, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(data = mubsey, aes(x = Years, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = "Multi-use areas"), alpha = 0.2) +
  # Customize scales
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Fully protected areas" = "#0072B2", "Multi-use areas" = "#E69F00")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fully protected areas" = "#0072B2", "Multi-use areas" = "#E69F00")) +
  # Scientific notation for y-axis
  #scale_y_continuous(
    #labels = scales::label_number(), 
                     #limits=c(0, 1e06)) +
scale_y_continuous(
  labels = scales::label_number()
  # remove limits= here
) +
coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1e6), clip = "on") +  # zoom without dropping rows
  # Apply theme
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "serif"), 
        #panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        #panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "right", 
        #axis.title = element_blank(), # remove axis titles
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.25) # change thickness of the outside boarder
        ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linetype = "solid")  # show solid lines in legend
    )) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Establishment phase (years)",
    y = "Estimated establishment costs (US$/km²)",
    color = "Degree of Protection",
    fill = "Degree of Protection")

# Creating inset plot with log10 scale for the y axis
leyear_pl <- 
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = fpey, aes(x = Years, y = median), color = "#0072B2", size = 0.8) + #, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = mubsey, aes(x = Years, y = median), color = "#E69F00", size = 0.8) + #, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ribbon(data = fpey, aes(x = Years, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_ribbon(data = mubsey, aes(x = Years, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "#E69F00", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_point(data = esubs, aes(x = Years, y = Cost_km, color = Protection_level),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Fully protected" = "#0072B2", "Partially protected" = "#E69F00"),
    labels = c("Fully protected" = "Fully protected areas",
               "Partially protected" = "Multi-use areas")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
    breaks = c(10, 1000, 100000, 10000000),
    labels = scales::label_log(),
    limits = c(0, 1e7)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "serif", size=10),
         axis.title = element_blank(),
         # These lines remove the grid
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) 

png("../Results/Figure.3.png", width = 2000, height = 2000, res = 300)  
#tot_years <- 
  neyear_pl +
  inset_element(
    leyear_pl,
     left = 0.02, 
    bottom = 0.6,
    right = 0.8,
    top = 0.98)
dev.off()

#final_plot + tot_years + plot_annotation(
   # theme = theme(
    #  plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.41, size = 10, family = "serif")),
    # caption = "Establishment phase (years)")
```

# plotting GDP per capita vs establishment costs

```{r}
# setting the model formula
formGDP = bf(Cost_km ~ GDP_pc, family = lognormal)
#model_gdp = lm(lCost_km ~ GDP_pc, family=gaussian, data = )
# running the model with priors only
GDP.brm1 = brm(formGDP, 
               data=esubs,
               sample_prior='yes', 
               iter= 5000, 
               warmup = 1000, 
               chains=3, 
               cores = 3, 
               thin=5, 
               refresh=0, 
               seed=123, 
               control = list(adapt_delta=0.99, max_treedepth=29),
               backend = "cmdstanr")

# Assess priors and posteriors
GDP.brm1 |> SUYR_prior_and_posterior()
# summarising results
#thorough results
GDP.brm1 |> 
  as_draws_df() |>  
  dplyr::select(matches("^b_.*")) |> 
  summarise_draws(
    median=median, 
                  hdi = ~HDInterval::hdi(.x),
                  rhat, 
                  ess_bulk,
                  Pl = ~mean(.x<0), 
                  Pg = ~mean(.x>0),
                  se = ~sd(.x))
```

## Plotting establisxhment costs x GDP per capita

```{r}
esubs <- esubs |> 
  filter(!is.na(GDP_pc))
newGDPseq <- seq(min(esubs$GDP_pc),
                 max(esubs$GDP_pc),
                 length.out = 100)
# getting the predicted draws
pred_draws_GDP_e <- emmeans(
  GDP.brm1,
  ~ GDP_pc,
  at = list(GDP_pc = newGDPseq
    #GDP_pc = seq(min(esubs$GDP_pc), max(esubs$GDP_pc), length.out = 100)
  )) |>
  gather_emmeans_draws()

# Now safely summarise per lSize using purrr
pred_GDP_e <- pred_draws_GDP_e |>
  group_by(GDP_pc) |>
  summarise(
    estimate = median(.value),
    lower = quantile(.value, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(.value, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    response = exp(estimate),
    lower = exp(lower),
    upper = exp(upper))

# creating the base plot
GDP_base <- 
  ggplot(pred_GDP_e, aes(x = GDP_pc, y = response)) +
    geom_line(size = 0.8, color = "#8C1D40") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "#800020", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_number()) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "serif"),
          panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2)
          #panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
          #panel.grid.major=element_blank()) +
          ) +
    labs(
      x = "GDP per capita (thousand US$)",
      y = "Estimated establishment costs (US$/km²)", 
      title = " ") + 
   coord_cartesian(
     xlim = c(0, 90000),
     ylim = c(0, 200000), 
     clip = "on") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = "A", hjust = 1.7, vjust = 0, size = 5, fontface = "bold", family = 'serif')
GDP_base

# creating the inset plot with log10 scale for the y axis
GDP_inset <-
 ggplot(pred_GDP_e, aes(x = GDP_pc, y = response)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.8, color = "#8C1D40") +  # thinner line
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), fill = "#800020", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_point(data = esubs, aes(x = GDP_pc, y = Cost_km), color = "#8C1D40") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "serif"), 
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
    breaks = c(10, 1000, 100000, 10000000),
    labels = scales::label_log(),
    limits = c(0, 1e7)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3),
    limits = c(0, 90000))
GDP_inset
# combining base and inset plot for establishment
est_GDP <- 
  GDP_base + inset_element(
    GDP_inset,
    left = 0.3, # 30% distance from the left  
    bottom = 0.45, # 45% distance from the bottom
    right = 0.95, 
    top = 0.98)

# combining establishment and maintenance gdp per capita plots 
total_GDP <- 
  est_GDP + GDP 
png("../Results/Figure GDP.png", width = 2500, height = 1600, res = 300)
total_GDP
dev.off()
```

# Coefficient plot

## Establishment coefficients
```{r}
# checking the names of the variables - first deletion
rownames(fixef(esubs.brm2))
# checking predictors names - full model
rownames(fixef(esubs.brm1))
# saving posterior draws
posterior_draws_e <- esubs.brm1 |> 
  as_draws_df() |>  
  dplyr::select(matches("^b_.*"), 
                -b_Intercept) |> 
  summarise_draws(
    median = median, 
    hdi = ~HDInterval::hdi(.x),
    rhat, 
    ess_bulk,
    Pl = ~mean(.x<0), 
    Pg = ~mean(.x>0), 
    se = ~sd(.x))
# filtering out the interaction because first deletion
posterior_draw_interaction <- posterior_draws_e |> 
  filter(variable == "b_lSize:Protection_levelPartiallyprotected")
# 1st deletion of the interaction term 
posterior_draws_1_delition_int <- esubs.brm2 |>
  as_draws_df() |>  
  dplyr::select(matches("^b_.*"), 
                -b_Intercept) |> 
  summarise_draws(
    median = median, 
                  hdi = ~HDInterval::hdi(.x),
                  rhat, 
                  ess_bulk,
                  Pl = ~mean(.x<0), 
                  Pg = ~mean(.x>0),
                  se = ~sd(.x))
# create teh raw posterior draws for teh halfeye
posterior_halfeye <- esubs.brm2 |>
  as_draws_df() |>
  dplyr::select(
    b_lSize,
    b_Years,
    b_Protection_levelPartiallyprotected) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "estimate")
# create teh draws for halfeye for the interaction 
posterior_halfeye_interaction <- esubs.brm1 |>
  as_draws_df() |>
  dplyr::select(
    `b_lSize:Protection_levelPartiallyprotected`) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "estimate")
# combine draws
posterior_halfeye_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  posterior_halfeye,
  posterior_halfeye_interaction)
# give predictors names for the halfeye plot
posterior_halfeye_all <- posterior_halfeye_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    predictor = dplyr::case_when(
      variable == "b_lSize" ~ 
        "ln(Area)",
      variable == "b_Years" ~ 
        "Duration",
      variable == "b_Protection_levelPartiallyprotected" ~ 
        "Degree of protection¹\nMulti-use areas",
      variable == "b_lSize:Protection_levelPartiallyprotected" ~ 
        "Interaction¹\nln(Area):Multi-use areas"))
# set predictors order
posterior_halfeye_all <- posterior_halfeye_all |>
  mutate(predictor = factor(predictor,levels = c(
        "Interaction¹\nln(Area):Multi-use areas",
        "ln(Area)", 
        "Duration",
        "Degree of protection¹\nMulti-use areas")))
# calculate teh posterior probabilities
posterior_probs <- posterior_halfeye_all |>
  group_by(predictor) |>
  summarise(
    prob_greater_0 = mean(estimate > 0),
    prob_less_0 = mean(estimate < 0),
    .groups = "drop")

# making coefficient plot for establishment regression
est_coef <- ggplot(posterior_halfeye_all, aes(x = estimate, y = predictor)) +
  # Final-model coefficients: light/dark blue split at zero
  ggdist::stat_slab(
  data = posterior_halfeye_all |>
    dplyr::filter(
      variable != "b_lSize:Protection_levelPartiallyprotected"), aes(fill = after_stat(x > 0)), colour = "grey20", 
  linewidth = 0.4,
  scale = 0.9,
  normalize = "groups") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "lightsteelblue2",`TRUE` = "royalblue4"), guide = "none") +
  # start a separate fill scale for teh interaction 
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  # Interaction from the first deletion: burgundy
  ggdist::stat_slab(
  data = posterior_halfeye_all |>
    dplyr::filter(variable == "b_lSize:Protection_levelPartiallyprotected"), aes(fill = after_stat(x > 0)), colour = "#8C1D40",
  linewidth = 0.4,
  scale = 0.9,
  normalize = "groups") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#D8A6B5", `TRUE`  = "#8C1D40"), guide = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Posterior estimate",
    y = NULL,
    title = "A - Total establishment costs (US$/km²)") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-4, 4)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "serif"),
    #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    #axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black", vjust = 0),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
est_coef
```

## Maintenance coefficients
```{r}
# checking the names of the variables - first deletion
rownames(fixef(msubs.brm2))
# checking predictors names - full model
rownames(fixef(msubs.brm1))
# saving posterior drws for maintenance
posterior_draws_m <- msubs.brm1 |>
  as_draws_df() |>  
  dplyr::select(matches("^b_.*"), 
                -b_Intercept) |> 
  summarise_draws(
    median = median, 
                  hdi = ~HDInterval::hdi(.x),
                  rhat, 
                  ess_bulk,
                  Pl = ~mean(.x<0), 
                  Pg = ~mean(.x>0),
                  se = ~sd(.x))
# filtering out GDP because first deletion
posterior_draw_gdp <- posterior_draws_m |> 
  filter(variable == "b_GDP_pc")
# posterior draws after first delition
posterior_draws_1_deletion <- msubs.brm2 |>
  as_draws_df() |>  
  dplyr::select(matches("^b_.*"), 
                -b_Intercept) |> 
  summarise_draws(
    median = median, 
                  hdi = ~HDInterval::hdi(.x),
                  rhat, 
                  ess_bulk,
                  Pl = ~mean(.x<0), 
                  Pg = ~mean(.x>0),
                  se = ~sd(.x))
# create teh raw posterior draws for teh halfeye
posterior_halfeye_m <- msubs.brm2 |>
  as_draws_df() |>
  dplyr::select(
    matches("^b_"),
    -b_Intercept) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "estimate")
# extract GDP from posterior from the full model
posterior_halfeye_gdp <- msubs.brm1 |>
  as_draws_df() |>
  dplyr::select(
    b_GDP_pc) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "estimate")
# combining the posterior draws for halfeye plot
posterior_halfeye_m_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  posterior_halfeye_m,
  posterior_halfeye_gdp)
# giving maintenacne predictors names for the halfeye plot
posterior_halfeye_m_all <- posterior_halfeye_m_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    predictor = dplyr::case_when(
      variable == "b_lSize" ~ "ln(Area)",
      variable == "b_GDP_pc" ~ "GDP per capita",
      variable == "b_Protection_levelPartiallyprotected" ~"Degree of protection¹\nMulti-use areas",
      variable == "b_lSize:Protection_levelPartiallyprotected" ~ "Interaction¹\nln(Area):Multi-use areas"))
# set y axis order
posterior_halfeye_m_all <- posterior_halfeye_m_all |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    predictor = factor(
      predictor,
      levels = c(
        "GDP per capita", 
        "ln(Area)", 
        "Degree of protection¹\nMulti-use areas",
        "Interaction¹\nln(Area):Multi-use areas")))
# calculate posterior probabilities 
posterior_probs_m <- posterior_halfeye_m_all |>
  dplyr::group_by(predictor) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    prob_greater_0 = mean(estimate > 0),
    prob_less_0 = mean(estimate < 0),
    .groups = "drop")
# plotting coefficient plot for maintenance regression
maint_coef <- ggplot(
  posterior_halfeye_m_all,
  aes(x = estimate, y = predictor)) +
  # Final-model predictors
  ggdist::stat_slab(data = posterior_halfeye_m_all |>
      dplyr::filter(variable != "b_GDP_pc"), aes(fill = after_stat(x > 0)), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.4,
    scale = 0.9,
    normalize = "groups") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      `FALSE` = "lightsteelblue2",
      `TRUE`  = "royalblue4"), guide = "none") +
  # New fill scale for deleted GDP predictor
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  # GDP: first deletion
  ggdist::stat_slab(
    data = posterior_halfeye_m_all |>
      dplyr::filter(variable == "b_GDP_pc"), aes(fill = after_stat(x > 0)),
    colour = "#8C1D40", linewidth = 0.4, scale = 0.9, normalize = "groups") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      `FALSE` = "#D8A6B5",
      `TRUE`  = "#8C1D40"), guide = "none") +
  # Zero-effect reference
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    x = "Posterior estimate",
    y = NULL,
    title = "B - Total maintenance costs (US$/km²/year)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "serif"),
    #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    #axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black", vjust = 0), 
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
maint_coef

# Combining plots
coefficient_plots <- est_coef + maint_coef
# Export the plot
png("../Results/coefficients plot.png", width = 2800, height = 1400, res = 300)
coefficient_plots
dev.off()
```

# Extra stats - editor
```{r}
mE_offset <- bf(Cost_km ~ offset(log(Size)) + Years, family = lognormal)
offset_brms <- brm(mE_offset, 
               data = esubs, 
               sample_prior ='yes', 
               iter = 5000, 
               warmup = 1000, 
               chains = 3, 
               cores = 3, 
               thin = 5, 
               refresh = 0, 
               seed = 123, 
               control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 29),
               backend = "cmdstanr")

mE_cov <- bf(Cost_km ~ log(Size) + Years, family = lognormal)
cov_brms <- brm(mE_cov, 
               data = esubs, 
               sample_prior ='yes', 
               iter = 5000, 
               warmup = 1000, 
               chains = 3, 
               cores = 3, 
               thin = 5, 
               refresh = 0, 
               seed = 123, 
               control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 29),
               backend = "cmdstanr")

loo_compare(loo(offset_brms), loo(cov_brms))
```
